description: LESYIV crystallizes in the rhombohedral crystal system with space group R 3 c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C36 H40 Dy2 N9 O11 1+,C1 H4 O1,N1 O3 1-,2(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.973-3.973 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.43-110.97°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C37H48Dy2N10O17. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
